This is an actual inconsistency in deduplication logic introduced by this diff.

record.issue_text: Case-sensitive guest === attendee.email dedup check allows duplicate attendees with differing email casing

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, deduplication uses a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` when building `uniqueGuests`. Since neither `guest` nor `attendee.email` is normalized (e.g., lowercased) and the schema only validates `.email()` without normalization, the handler can add duplicates like `User@Example.com` alongside existing `user@example.com`. The frontend uniqueness check in `AddGuestsDialog` (`new Set(emails)`) is also case-sensitive, so it doesn’t prevent this either.
